title: Harlingen Convention Center
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The environment in which you host your meeting or event matters just as much as the catered food, the décor or even the number of people who attend. With approximately 25,000 square feet of dedicated meeting and event space, the Harlingen Convention Center has ten meeting rooms, eight of which can be combined to create a large ballroom that can host 1,500+ guests.
